title: Fog Settings
description: Defines fog rendering settings used by resource packs.

minecraft:fog_settings.title: Fog Settings
minecraft:fog_settings.description:
Properties:
• description ({ identifier })
• distance ({ air, weather, water, ... })
• volumetric ({ density, media_coefficients })

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier for these fog settings. The identifier must include a namespace.

defaultSnippets.label: Description
defaultSnippets.description: Create a Description

distance.title: Distance
distance.description:
The distance fog settings for different camera locations.

Properties:
• air ({ render_distance_type, transition_fog })
• weather ({ render_distance_type, transition_fog })
• water ({ render_distance_type, transition_fog })
• lava ({ render_distance_type, transition_fog })
• lava_resistance ({ render_distance_type, transition_fog })
• powder_snow ({ render_distance_type, transition_fog })

air.title: Air
air.description:
The fog settings when the camera is in the air.

Properties:
• render_distance_type (string)
• transition_fog ({ init_fog })

render_distance_type.title: Render Distance Type"<"fixed", "render"
render_distance_type.description: Determines how distance value is used. Fixed distance is measured in blocks. Dynamic distance is multiplied by the current render distance.

transition_fog.title: Transition Fog
transition_fog.description:
Additional fog data which will slowly transition to the distance fog of current biome.

Properties:
• init_fog ({ render_distance_type })

init_fog.description:
